evaluation_target.rationale: The hazard defines the unwanted event as the vehicle suddenly stopping with no obstacle in front, and SG-3 states that the system shall prevent unintended braking.

phenomenon_of_interest.statement: Braking behavior of the ego vehicle in the stated operational situation, including whether braking occurs and whether it is intended or unintended.
phenomenon_of_interest.scope: Straight ahead drive on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, with no visible obstacles or vehicles in front of the ego vehicle, under good weather conditions.
phenomenon_of_interest.rationale: The concern is about the vehicle’s braking behavior in the specific driving situation described by the hazard; the phenomenon must include the occurrence and character of braking so the safety goal can be evaluated.

distinctions.rationale: Whether braking occurs is necessary to evaluate prevention of unintended braking; collapsing braking and non-braking would remove the information needed to determine whether the hazardous event has occurred.

distinctions.contrast_a: Braking is intended as part of a valid braking maneuver to avoid a collision with an obstacle.
distinctions.contrast_b: Braking is unintended, i.e. the vehicle suddenly stops although no obstacle is in front of the vehicle.
distinctions.rationale: The hazard and FR-7 distinguish braking to avoid collisions from unintended braking; collapsing intended and unintended braking would remove the information needed to judge whether the safety goal is violated.

orrs.obligation: An admissible Observable Representation shall preserve whether the ego vehicle is braking or not braking in the declared operational situation.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must distinguish the presence of a braking event from the absence of a braking event.

orrs.obligation: An admissible Observable Representation shall preserve whether any braking event is intended as a collision-avoidance maneuver or is unintended.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must distinguish intended braking from unintended braking.

assumptions.statement: The operational representation can relate braking behavior to the presence or absence of obstacles in front of the ego vehicle.

revalidation_conditions.condition: If the operational situation or safety goal changes so that braking may be justified by factors other than obstacle avoidance.
